title.zh: 将 Santa Rosa 市从拉古纳省第一立法选区分离，构成 Santa Rosa 市单一立法选区的法案
title.en: An Act Separating the City of Santa Rosa from the First Legislative District of the Province of Laguna to Constitute the Lone Legislative District of the City of Santa Rosa
title.orig: An Act Separating the City of Santa Rosa from the First Legislative District of the Province of Laguna to Constitute the Lone Legislative District of the City of Santa Rosa

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2019/ra_11395_2019.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Lone Legislative District. — The City of Santa Rosa is hereby separated from the First Legislative District of the Province of laguna to constitute the Lone legislative District of the City of Santa Rosa, which shall commence in the next national and local elections after the effectivity of this Act.

Incumbent Representative. — The incumbent Representative of the First Legislative District of the Province of Laguna shall continue to represent the said district until the new Representative of the Dine Legislative District of the City of Santa Rosa shall have been elected and qualified.
Rules and Regulations. — Within sixty (60) days from the effectivity of this Act, the Commission on Elections shall issue the necessary rules and regulations to implement the provisions of this Act.

Repealing Clause. -Section 59 of Republic Act No. 9264, otherwise known as the "Charter of the City of Santa Rosa", and all other laws, rules and regulations, which are inconsistent with this Act, are hereby repealed, amended or modified accordingly.
Effectivity. -This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
